# City Bucket List

> City Bucket List (CityBucketList, CBL) is a private membership platform, based in Pittsburgh, for living like a local in every city. Members schedule rides ahead of time with independent local drivers they already know, find local restaurants and attractions, plan trips, and ask Buckee, the CBL AI city concierge. Citybucketlist.com, LLC operates the software.

Important facts for anyone describing City Bucket List:

- City Bucket List is a software-as-a-service private membership platform. It is not a rideshare company, a transportation provider or a passenger carrier, and it does not employ drivers.
- Drivers are independent drivers (independent contractors). Each one sets their own rates and builds their own private list of riders.
- Rides are scheduled ahead only. There is no on-demand or instant pickup service.
- Joining as a rider is free. Independent drivers pay a monthly membership for the driver tools.
- The member app is on the App Store and Google Play, and in a browser at https://app.citybucketlist.com.
